newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - May 13.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - May 13.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Bangladesh Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina on Monday mooted a proposal for creating South Asian Economic Community for attaining a rapid economic growth in the region through intensive cooperation.
Japan has agreed to provide 15.2 billion Yen in fresh loan to Bangladesh to fund three infrastructural projects.
About 19 percent of the Bangladeshi children between the age of five and 14 are labourers, according to a sample survey conducted by the Bangladesh Bureau of Statistics.
A total of 54 Bangladeshis are languishing in Mormi prison of Myanmar.

Former President Hussain Mohammad Ershad said on Monday his Jatiya Party would not participate in any future election under the present governemnt if rigging took place in the forthcoming Manikganj bypolls.
Two tribals were arrested in the hill district of Banderban on Monday in connection with the May 3 incident in which a border guard and two tribal insurgents had been killed
State Minister for Health M Aman Ullah on Monday said the government was considering a proposal to allow foreign doctors to practice in Bangladesh.
Sri Lanka said it would buy jute goods, including jute wrapping bags, from Bangladesh.
